embed.title: !language
embed.description: Change the language the bot uses for its replies and your alerts.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}language` — show your language and the ones available
`{{prefix}}language de` — set it by code
`{{prefix}}language deutsch` — or by name, as shown in the list

Which languages are available is up to your admin.

fields.name: What changes
fields.value:
• Pokemon, form, move, type, item and weather names in alerts
• Bot replies, help and error messages
• Alert layouts, if your admin has made language-specific ones

The setting applies to your whole account, not one profile. English command words always work, as do the translated command words of the languages this server offers.
